items.summary: Create a stable Operations data structure in backend/main.mo with fields: operation_id (Nat, primary key) and operation_name (Text), pre-populated with exactly 17 fixed operations in sequential order: 1=Boxing, 2=Welding/Finishing, 3=Rear Wall, 4=Front Wall, 5=Side Wall, 6=Roof, 7=Rear Door, 8=Blasting & Primer, 9=Final Paint, 10=Gasket, 11=DLM, 12=Plywood, 13=Floor Screw, 14=Decal, 15=Data Plate, 16=Sikha, 17=Black Paint
Create a backend query function getAllOperations in backend/main.mo that returns all 17 Operations records with their operation_id and operation_name values in sequential order (1-17)
Remove all backend functions that allow adding, deleting, or modifying operation entries (if any exist), ensuring operations remain permanently locked to the predefined 17

Update the createDailyProductionReport backend function in backend/main.mo to validate that the operation_id parameter is between 1-17 inclusive, returning an error if the operation_id is out of range or does not match an existing operation

Update the updateDailyProductionReport backend function in backend/main.mo to prevent any changes to the operation_id field, rejecting update attempts that try to change the operation assignment with an appropriate error message

Update the ContainerDailyReportEntryPage component at frontend/src/pages/ContainerDailyReportEntryPage.tsx to always display all 17 predefined operations in exact sequential order (1-17) in the production entry table, fetching operation data from the getAllOperations backend function

Update the ContainerDailyReportPage component at frontend/src/pages/ContainerDailyReportPage.tsx to always display all 17 predefined operations in exact sequential order (1-17) in the daily report view, showing zero or empty values for operations with no production data for the selected date

Update all production dashboard and history components (ProductionDashboardPage, ProductionHistoryPage, DailyProductionReportTable) to display operations in the predefined sequential order (1-17) when showing production data, using operation_id for sorting and operation_name for display

Ensure the useGetAllOperations React Query hook at frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllOperations.ts correctly fetches all 17 operations from the backend, with proper error handling and loading states, and returns operations in sequential order by operation_id

Add comprehensive validation in the ContainerDailyReportEntryPage save functionality to ensure all production records being saved reference valid operation_ids (1-17), displaying user-friendly error messages if validation fails
